messages.text:
"* **Genre:** Top-down action RPG / action-platformer featuring **16-bit Pixel Art** aesthetics.
* **Visual Style:**
* A dark, melancholic color palette of muted industrial tones, contrasted sharply by bright elemental energy bursts (electric blue, blazing red, pure white).
* Compact, detailed pixel-sprite characters (*chibi-style*) featuring fluid attack and elemental channeling animations.
* Environments blending decaying technological ruins with natural overgrowth: rusted metal structures, dangling cables, and flickering terminals scattered across organic ground.


* **Core Gameplay Mechanics:**
* The player controls a solitary figure capable of switching and channeling **primary elements** (fire, water, wind, stone, lightning, ice, light, and shadow) in real-time to solve environmental puzzles and combat automated enemies or corrupted system remnants.
* Fast-paced combat system centered on close-range physical strikes and short-burst elemental attacks that alter the surroundings (such as freezing circuits, dissipating energy barriers, or overloading terminals with lightning).


* **Progression and Structure:**
* **Title Screen:** An old CRT monitor sitting in a dark room with static interference, displaying a flickering pixelated game logo and a rudimentary start button.
* **Opening Level (Introduction):** An interactive prologue where the character ascends a ruined industrial tower amid an electrical storm, collecting luminous memory fragments while surrounding machinery malfunctions and shuts down in a chain reaction. Upon reaching the summit, a beam of light shoots into the sky, transitioning the game into a retro-style geometric loading screen. (App)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

Built **NULL / ASCENT**, a complete browser-playable pixel-art action game.

- **Title screen:** Flickering CRT, static, and a start prompt.
- **Prologue:** Ascend the storm-battered tower, fight automated enemies, and collect five memory fragments.
- **Combat and elements:** Strike with **Space**; channel with **E**; cycle all eight elements with **Q** or select them with **1–8**. Use **WASD** or the arrow keys to move.
- **Tower puzzle:** Overload the security relay with **Volt (lightning)** to open the barrier, then reach the summit and send the signal.
- **Progression:** Find a memory link to restore vitality; elemental channels provide different combat and traversal effects.
